title: Airspeed Indicator
text: Display measurements for aircraft airspeed, {Scale Colors} sets Ranges of color bands; {Connection} sets the connect to signal, {Minimum}, {Maximum} and {Label} sets the name of connected. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Minimum
params.values: Minimum tick mark value 40 (default) | finite | double | scalar

params.name: Maximum
params.values: Maximum tick mark value 400 (default) | finite | double | scalar

params.name: Scale Colors
params.values: Ranges of color bands 0 (default) | double | scalar

params.name: Label
params.values: Name of connected signal Top (default) | Bottom | Hide
